currentGuideFindings: Published changes apply to new tasks; an existing task retains its own state.
Environment variables deliver direct process values; network secrets deliver placeholders substituted by the proxy on permitted HTTPS destinations.
Only environment-requested personal keys reach the task.
An environment variable and a network secret must not share a key.
legacyGuideAppliesTo: Legacy Code Review and Linear/GitHub integrations, not the current web/mobile/desktop cloud environment workflow.
legacyFinding: Legacy secrets are setup-only and removed before the agent phase; do not use legacy setup-secret persistence tricks.
runtimeDiagnosis: Both expected variables absent before and after dotenv; cloud metadata has no source configuration, runtime variables or secret bindings. Editor contents, ownership and publication times inaccessible.
recommendation: For the unmodified Basic-auth client, configure the exact expected keys as direct Environment variables in the saved private Waylatch environment, then republish and start a new task through Work in > Cloud > Waylatch. Network-secret substitution inside this client's derived Base64 header is not independently verified; do not claim support or silently change modes.
